description: Customer race or ethnicity stored as categorical text. All 30 records are populated with 6 distinct observed values representing three categories: Chinese, Indian, and Malay. Casing inconsistencies detected for Indian and Malay entries, with values appearing in lowercase ('indian', 'malay') and uppercase ('MALAY') variants.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Unify casing to title case for ethnic group names: 'MALAY' → 'Malay', 'malay' → 'Malay', 'indian' → 'Indian'.
